scope: Every .py blob under Logic/PrimitiveRecursiveArithmetic/ConciseIPRA/Research, including nested reference and evidence copies
metric_definition: Recursively remove actual Module, FunctionDef, AsyncFunctionDef and ClassDef docstrings (first Expr Constant str). Insert Pass only in an emptied function or class body. ast.unparse; append one LF; reparse. Count normalized UTF-8 bytes, non-layout/comment tokens, and every node from ast.walk of the normalized program.
limits: The coordinate envelope is attained by three different existing programs; it is not one program with all three scores.
This is an empirical source-corpus envelope, not a mathematical lower bound on every equivalent presentation.
No source code was executed by the audit. Existing metatheorem claims are inherited, not formally reverified here.
Scripts smaller in one coordinate that merely build reports, generate sources, measure code, run tests, or import a local checker are excluded from the standalone-checker classification.
Compact protocols and fully syntax-validated public formula checkers have different acceptance contracts. Compare matched contracts separately.
The corpus covers Research Python files at the pinned commit, not contents embedded only in compressed archives or non-Python programs.
source_code_execution_policy: Repository source files are treated as data: SHA-verified, decoded, parsed and normalized, never executed by the corpus audit. Only the new audit/reproduction utilities are executed.
